# `fnox profiles`

- **Usage:** `fnox profiles`

List available profiles

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Inspect the available profile names before selecting or composing them. Use --write-profile when writing with multiple active profiles.

```sh
fnox profiles
fnox -P aws,staging list
```
